steps.label: suche
montage
steps.run: cd "$JOB_DIR" && ls th | head -200 > /dev/null; FF="npx --prefix $AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film remotion ffmpeg"; cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && for f in "$JOB_DIR"/th/*.jpg; do npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i "$f" -vf 'scale=240:240:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=240:240:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:color=white' "${f%.jpg}_s.png" || true; done; i=0; mkdir -p "$JOB_DIR/seq"; for k in $(seq 1 100); do s=$(printf '%s/th/%03d_s.png' "$JOB_DIR" $k); [ -f "$s" ] || s=""; if [ -n "$s" ]; then cp "$s" $(printf '%s/seq/%03d.png' "$JOB_DIR" $k); else npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -f lavfi -i color=c=gray:s=240x240 -frames:v 1 $(printf '%s/seq/%03d.png' "$JOB_DIR" $k); fi; done; npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -framerate 1 -start_number 1 -i "$JOB_DIR/seq/%03d.png" -vf 'tile=10x10' -frames:v 1 -q:v 3 "$JOB_DIR/thumbs.jpg"; ls -l "$JOB_DIR/thumbs.jpg"
